description: Offline deterministic regression suite for historical docudrama & What-If prompts (zero paid calls).

cases.prompt: Slow horizontal truck across a rain-soaked 1914 trench parapet as lanterns flicker in cold mist and soldiers brace along wooden duckboards. Ambient rain and distant artillery thunder; no speech, no dialogue.

Subtle zoom_in on General Vance leaning over a candlelit linen map table as ink shadows shift across his brow. Vance says in a weathered low baritone: "Hold the eastern ridge until dawn." Faint parchment rustle and distant wind.
Clean dark-relief regional cartography of the Meuse sector with crimson and slate front-line vectors advancing steadily from 14 October to 21 October.
Render in Unreal Engine with masterpiece, best quality, 8k and Qwen-LoRA style. No speech.
360-orbit around the general standing on the hill while he talks about the battle.
Wide aerial pull back over the frozen harbor as steam rises from ironclad funnels at first light.
